confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of San Sebastian's pricing, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel prices are least certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by week and location. Cocktail and wine were estimated directly from local bar pricing, not derived from beer. FX: the 15 Oct 2026 RBA figure (0.6955) was reported in web search results as the RBA homepage rate. I did not open the RBA page directly. A 16 Oct figure (0.6947) appeared only on a third-party site, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to other high-cost Basque and northern Spanish coastal cities, such as Bilbao and Biarritz, with adjustments for San Sebastian's strong summer tourism demand, its pintxos bar culture, and its premium hotel pricing in July.
